label: Weaken infinite-suffix freedom to exact one-bit and adjacent-pair exposure conditions (inference)
rule: Construct a profile excluding any missing pair, compare opposite-value histories on one record, and reuse finite recombination
meaning: An absent adjacent pair defines a time-specific exclusion Profile holding on every admitted trace. Conversely any realized pair must satisfy every universal Profile. Opposite values at one coordinate defeat common-record exact estimators, while absence of one Boolean value permits a correct constant estimator. Finite richness realizes each pair through a finite prefix, and #1874's recombinationFork supplies it from populated one-step extension.
